quests.title: Cat and Cog

dialogue.t: Mm, delicious tea and delectable snacks. Thank you for your hospitality, Miss Sandrone.
I'm glad you like it. I also brought some snacks for Ashru. Isn't that right, Ashru? Come here. There's a good kitty.
Meow~
I hope your warm feelings for Nod-Krai and the Curatorium of Secrets will prove beneficial to our future cooperation.
I hope so too. Here, Ashru, try one of these.
Also, regarding that matter I enquired about before...
Hehe, your little paws are so soft...
Miss Sandrone... Don't tell me you used this tea party as a pretext to come here and dote on my cat?
Huh...? M—Me? I would never! I take my dealings with the Curatorium of Secrets very seriously!
Ashru, come here.
Meow~
Aww...
Then let's talk about the details of our "dealings," shall we?
...Hmph. S—So what if I wanted to pet Ashru... Who wouldn't!?

Small animals are usually wary of machines. It took a lot of work to get Ashru to trust me when I was here working on the numerological array. What's so wrong with me wanting to give him a belly rub or two...
Hah... No need to get so defensive.
Go on, Ashru. It's not like it's my place to tell you who you can or can't rub up against.
Meow~
But once you're done petting him, don't forget we have business to discuss...
Like I told you, I take our dealings very seriously!
Tea tastes so much better when paired with useful intel...

dialogue.sit: (Let's sit like this for a little while longer.)
I think it's time I started clearing up.

dialogue.t: Oh, take care. And remember to drop by whenever you're free.

quests.description: Go to the Curatorium of Secrets, place your tea table, and have Sandrone take a seat. Then, prepare to enjoy some tea with Nefer…
